jobs.title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
jobs.description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods
jobs.description:
About the position

A position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Stochastic Analysis and Computational Methods is available at Department of Mathematics, within the section of Risk and Stochastics.

Starting date no later than January 31st, 2027.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities). 

Depending upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department, a fourth year may be considered. In this case, a workload of 25% is devoted to career promoting work, usually in the form of teaching and/or supervision duties. In this case, Postdoctoral fellows who are appointed for a period of four years are expected to acquire basic pedagogical competency in the course of their fellowship period within the duty component of 25%.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

The position is bounded to the SURE-AI consortium agreement and its research scopes. The Centre for Sustainable, Risk-Averse, and Ethical AI or SURE-AI is a Norwegian AI centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (2025-2030). The primary objective is to create a new generation of algorithms for inference and decision-making by pushing the boundaries of the underlying computational techniques. SURE-AI researchers will drive a transformative leap in AI through a groundbreaking Centre initiative dedicated to making Artificial Intelligence more efficient, transparent and safe, addressing the critical challenges of resource consumption, behaviour unpredictability and ethical alignment with human and societal values. The centre involves senior researchers from well-renowned national and international research institutions, in close collaboration with industry and public sector. Overall, SURE-AI includes 19 national Norwegian partners, as well as researchers from 15 international institutions.

Six national research centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI) were launched in the Fall of 2025. These centres will foster interdisciplinary collaboration among researchers to address both scientific and societal challenges, develop new technologies, understand the impact of AI, and drive innovation across both the business and public sectors. This initiative is established and financed through the government's significant investment in artificial intelligence over the next five years

The present postdoctoral position is hosted at the Department of Mathematics, at Blindern campus in Oslo, which is the place of work.


Project description

The position is framed in the strongly interdisciplinary research group of Risk and Stochastics and the Community of SURE-AI. The focus is on the development of original mathematical methods for AI and its applications aimed at the modelling and analysis of complex phenomena particularly within economics and finance, energy finance, sustainable and ethical economics and insurance. 

We are interested in research projects that are deeply grounded in stochastic analysis and show also development of computational methods towards machine learning. The projects will focus on applications to risk-sensitive decision making and control, with the potential to address ethical and human alignment in machine learning research.

For this, candidates with a strong background in the areas of stochastic analysis, Malliavin calculus, forward and backward stochastic differential equations, signature methods, filtering, machine learning and computational stochastics are particularly welcome and are prioritized. Clear interest in computational methods towards applications is appreciated.

We are interested in candidates that can merge into an internationally oriented group with high ambitions in research excellency. It is expected that the fellow takes active part in both the research development and the group’s activities. 

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in stochastic analysis, probability or mathematical statistics, numerical methods for stochastics, forward and/or backward stochastic differential equations, stochastic control, stochastic filtering. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • Interdisciplinary research experience and/or attitude in the relevant areas is an advantage. 
  • Knowledge of computational methods for stochastics and programming skills.
  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Malliavin calculus, stochastic filtering, risk measures, signature methods.
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language may be an advantage for teaching and supervision (if applicable)

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

The fellow is expected to take part in the activities of the Section of Risk and Stochastics. We are expecting a person able to work in structured manner both independently and as part of a team, swiftly adapting to new tasks. In general, a positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods is an advantage. A genuine interest in taking part in the various aspects of the academic life with collaborative and pro-active attitude is highly appreciated. 
Good communication skills are important.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Project description (no more than 3 pages, excluding references)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years)

No one can be appointed twice as a Postdoctoral fellow financed with funds from The Research Council of Norway (NFR).

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic.

We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.

Vi søker en effektiv og pålitelig bilklargjører til vårt team i Gjøvik. Hos oss får du en variert og fysisk arbeidshverdag med klargjøring av leiebiler, og vi ser etter deg som liker å jobbe praktisk, effektivt og nøye. Erfaring er ikke nødvendig – opplæring gis.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er nøye, pålitelig og tar stolthet i arbeidet du gjør. En bil skal ikke bare se ren ut -- den skal være ordentlig klargjort og klar for neste kunde.

Du må være grundig og ha et godt øye for detaljer, både når det gjelder vask og når du kontrollerer bilen for skader eller andre avvik. Vi ser også etter deg som tar ansvar, jobber selvstendig og sier ifra dersom du oppdager noe som ikke er som det skal.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring fra bilutleie eller bilpleie fra før. Det viktigste er at du er lærevillig, effektiv og opptatt av å gjøre en skikkelig jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Innlandet Bilutleie søker bilvasker / bilklargjører i Gjøvik

Vi søker en pålitelig og effektiv medarbeider til vask og klargjøring av våre leiebiler.

Arbeidsdagen vil hovedsakelig bestå av:

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask av biler

  • Støvsuging og rengjøring

  • Klargjøring og enkel kontroll av biler før utleie

  • Flytting av biler og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilparken

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er pålitelig og møter til avtalt tid

  • Jobber effektivt og er opptatt av et godt resultat

  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og høyt tempo

  • Kan jobbe selvstendig, men også fungerer godt sammen med andre

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

Tidligere erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig. Du vil få nødvendig opplæring.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet ca. 60 %, tilsvarende omtrent tre arbeidsdager i uken. Arbeidstid og konkrete dager avtales nærmere.

Vi ønsker en person som kan starte så snart som mulig.

Du trenger ikke skrive en lang søknad. Send oss noen korte ord om deg selv, når du kan starte og telefonnummeret ditt.

Arbeidssted: Gjøvik

Arbeidsgiver: Innlandet Bilutleie AS

Vi tilbyr

Hos Innlandet Bilutleie blir du en del av et lite og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier og varierte arbeidsdager. Du får ansvar og tillit tidlig, samtidig som du får god opplæring i oppgavene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et hyggelig og uformelt arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte arbeidsdager med praktiske oppgaver

  • God opplæring -- erfaring er ikke nødvendig

  • Selvstendig arbeid og ansvar

  • Mulighet til å lære mer om bil, bilutleie og drift

  • Forutsigbar deltidsstilling med mulighet for mer arbeid ved behov

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi er en liten organisasjon der alle bidrar, og hvor det er kort vei fra idé til handling. For den rette personen kan det også være muligheter for mer ansvar og flere oppgaver over tid.

Bilklargjører søkes til Innlandet Bilutleie -- 60 % stilling, førerkort klasse B kreves

jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work
jobs.description:
The University of Lapland invites applications for the position of Assistant or Associate Professor in Social Work (Tenure Track Levels 1-2) or Professor of Social Work.

The research profile of the position focuses on social and health care service systems, the effectiveness of social work, and information and knowledge practices in social work. Global and societal transformations are reshaping professional social work practice and welfare service systems. At the same time, digital technologies and artificial intelligence are significantly changing knowledge practices, information management, and the organization of social work within service systems.

These developments raise new questions related to social justice, ethics, and professional values, creating a need for critical scholarly inquiry and the strengthening of the research base of social work through interdisciplinary and international collaboration. The Assistant/Associate Professor/Professor is expected to provide academic leadership in research, monitor developments in the discipline, and contribute to societal engagement, international collaboration, and scholarly networks in social work. The position includes responsibility for teaching and curriculum development, particularly in courses related to social and health care service systems and social policy at the bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels. The successful candidate will supervise theses and doctoral dissertations and contribute to the development of teaching in collaboration with the degree programme staff.

The duties also include active collaboration with other faculties of the University of Lapland. The appointee will further strengthen international networks in research and education and participate in programme planning, administration, and academic governance. The position is located in the Discipline of Social Work, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Lapland. The discipline provides a multidisciplinary and dynamic academic environment. The position offers an opportunity to build and lead a nationally and internationally high-quality research in collaboration with the faculty's research communities and other faculties of the University. The successful candidate will be actively supported in applying for competitive research funding, building international research networks, and preparing interdisciplinary research projects.

The position requires regular presence at the University of Lapland campus in Rovaniemi.

- Diverse and inspiring tasks in research and education

- The stability and support of a well-established university

- Modern working facilities and tools

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

- Support from experienced colleagues and expert teams

- Comprehensive occupational health care

The University of Lapland offers a unique research and working environment characterized by northern social issues, the development of welfare services, international collaboration, and Arctic perspectives in social science research.

Applicants are required to hold a doctoral degree in Social Work and possess expertise in social work acquired through academic education and research. The position further requires the ability and motivation to develop multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary research collaboration within the university community as well as nationally and internationally.

- social and health care service systems

- the effectiveness of social work

- information management

- information and knowledge practices or

- digital environments and transformations in social work.

Applicants are expected to have a good command of English. Knowledge of Finnish or strong motivation to learn Finnish is also required. For an international applicant or a non-native Finnish speaker, reasonable proficiency in Finnish may be required within five years of appointment, if necessary. The University of Lapland supports international staff members in their integration into the university community and in learning Finnish. According to Section 30 of the University of Lapland Regulations, the criteria and evaluation procedures for Assistant Professorships (Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels) are defined within the University's Tenure Track model.

Additional merits include

- Evidence of multidisciplinary or interdisciplinary research collaboration within the academic community, nationally, or internationally

The position may be filled at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor (Tenure Track Level 1 or Level 2) or Professor, depending on the qualifications, achievements, and career stage of the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Myyjä S-market Viinijärvi määräaikainen työsuhde
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIPERI

Haemme myyjää S-market Viinijärvelle määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 31.10.2027 saakka. Työtunteja tarjoamme sinulle 25 h/viikko. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Haemme henkilöä, joilla hymy tulee luonnostaan, onhan meillä PKO:n vähittäiskaupassa kantavana ajatuksena hyvä mieli hymyllä. Ajattelemme, että hymy on asiakaskokemuksen mittari ja hymyn positiiviset vaikutukset eivät jää ainoastaan sen kantajaan.
Toivomme siis, että sinä nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja siitä, että saat työskennellä ihmisten parissa. Sinun asenteesi on positiivinen ja reipas, oma-aloitteinen työote on osa jokaista työpäivääsi.

Odotamme, että sinulla on hyvät asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Työ marketissamme on vuorotyötä, joka tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden vaihteleviin työvuoroihin ja joustavaan arkeen.
Kaupallinen koulutus antaa hyvän perustan tekemiselle, mutta arvostamme erityisesti oikeaa asennetta ja tahtotilaa palvella asiakkaita laadukkaasti. Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen asiakaspalvelutyöstä vähittäiskaupassa ja kaupan erilaisista tehtävistä, kuitenkaan aikaisempi kokemus ei ole välttämätöntä. Tärkeintä on oma-aloitteinen ote työhön, joustavuus ja halu tehdä työtä tiimissämme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, kivan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä halutessasi urallasi. Sinä saat käyttöösi sekä S-ryhmän että PKO:n erittäin hyvät, jopa Suomen parhaaksi kutsutut, henkilöstöedut (https://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut).
PKO tarjoaa myös keskimääräistä laajemmat ja kattavammat työterveyspalvelut ja työntekijämme ovat vakuutettu myös työajan ulkopuolella vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 16.10.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa marketpäällikkö Sanna-Riina Rouvari p. 010762 2820 arkisin 9-15 välillä tai sähköpostitsesanna-riina.rouvari@sok.fi.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.

 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

  • Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems

  • Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects

  • Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on

  • A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft

  • Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system

  • Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms

  • Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales

  • Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality

  • Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale

  • Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics

  • Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: Senior ICT System Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle als ICT System Engineer

Als erfahrener ICT System Engineer bist du ein essenzieller Teil unseres Teams. Du planst, realisierst und optimierst moderne ICT-Plattformen und stellst deren sicheren, stabilen und leistungsfähigen Betrieb sicher. Mit deinem technischen Know-how, deinem Blick für das Gesamtsystem und deiner lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise entwickelst du nachhaltige Infrastrukturlösungen für unsere Kunden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du designst, implementierst und betreibst komplexe System- und Plattformarchitekturen in On-Premises-, Cloud- und hybriden Umgebungen.
  • Du automatisierst Provisionierung, Konfiguration und Betrieb von Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure-as-Code und Configuration-Management-Tools wie Terraform, Ansible oder PowerShell.
  • Du entwickelst Skripte, Tools und Automatisierungen zur Standardisierung von Deployments, Betriebsprozessen und wiederkehrenden Engineering-Aufgaben.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst CI/CD-Pipelines für Infrastruktur-, Plattform- und Applikationskomponenten.
  • Du betreibst und optimierst virtualisierte und containerisierte Umgebungen, beispielsweise mit VMware, Hyper-V, Docker und Kubernetes.
  • Du integrierst Server-, Netzwerk-, Storage-, Identity- und Security-Komponenten zu stabilen und skalierbaren Gesamtsystemen.
  • Du konzipierst technische Lösungen für Netzwerksegmentierung, DNS, Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies, Firewalls, VPN und sichere Systemkommunikation.
  • Du implementierst Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen und nutzt Metriken, Logs und Traces zur Analyse komplexer Systemzustände.
  • Du analysierst Performance-Probleme, Netzwerkfehler, Ressourcenengpässe und komplexe Incidents bis auf Betriebssystem-, Netzwerk- oder Applikationsebene.
  • Du planst und realisierst Migrationen, Plattform-Upgrades, Systemablösungen und Cloud-Transformationen.
  • Du entwickelst technische Standards und Referenzarchitekturen für wiederverwendbare und automatisierbare Plattformen.
  • Du dokumentierst Architekturen, Konfigurationen, Abhängigkeiten, Betriebsprozesse und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und praxisnah.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Software Engineers, Security Engineers, Architekten und Kundenteams zusammen und übernimmst bei Bedarf die technische Führung innerhalb eines Projekts.


Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als System Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Server-Betriebssystem-Stack, beispielsweise Linux oder Windows Server.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, Firewalls, Load Balancing und grundlegenden Netzwerkarchitekturen.
  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungsplattformen wie VMware vSphere, Hyper-V oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer Public-Cloud-Plattform wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud.
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code, beispielsweise Terraform, sowie mit Konfigurationsautomatisierung über Ansible, PowerShell, Bash oder vergleichbare Technologien.
  • Gute Scripting- oder Programmierkenntnisse, beispielsweise in PowerShell, Python, Bash oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache.
  • Erfahrung mit Git-basierten Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Workflows.
  • Verständnis moderner CI/CD-Prozesse und Erfahrung mit Plattformen wie GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder Jenkins.
  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb und Troubleshooting produktiver ICT-Systeme mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Nachvollziehbarkeit.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Identity & Access Management, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, Secrets Management und grundlegenden Security-Prinzipien.
  • Erfahrung mit Backup-, Restore- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten und deren technischer Umsetzung.
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Fehler systematisch einzugrenzen und Probleme über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg zu analysieren.
  • Ein ausgeprägter Engineering-Mindset: Du automatisierst repetitive Arbeit, bevorzugst reproduzierbare Konfigurationen und behandelst Infrastruktur möglichst als Code.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute technische Englischkenntnisse.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und dem produktiven Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen.
  • Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Komponenten und -Ökosystemen wie Helm, Ingress Controller, Operators oder GitOps.
  • Kenntnisse mit GitOps-Werkzeugen wie Argo CD oder Flux.
  • Erfahrung mit Observability-Stacks wie Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elastic Stack oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
  • Erfahrung mit zentralem Log Management und SIEM-Plattformen.
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure, beispielsweise Entra ID, Azure Networking, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Monitor oder Azure Policy.
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-365-, Active-Directory- oder Entra-ID-Integrationen.
  • Erfahrung mit hybriden Identity-, Netzwerk- und Cloud-Architekturen.
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich PKI, Zertifikatsmanagement und Secrets Management, beispielsweise mit HashiCorp Vault oder Cloud-nativen Key-Management-Systemen.
  • Erfahrung mit API Gateways, Reverse Proxies und Webservern wie nginx, Traefik oder HAProxy.
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Software Development und Erfahrung beim Entwickeln kleiner interner Services, APIs oder Plattform-Tools.
  • Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, Message Queues oder verteilten Systemen.
  • Kenntnisse von Zero-Trust-, Hardening- und Security-Baseline-Konzepten.
  • Erfahrung mit Hochverfügbarkeits-, Failover- und Disaster-Recovery-Architekturen.
  • Erfahrung mit Immutable Infrastructure, automatisierten Image-Builds oder Configuration-as-Code.
  • Erfahrung mit grossen Enterprise- oder Verwaltungsumgebungen mit komplexen Abhängigkeiten und erhöhten Anforderungen an Security, Governance und Compliance.
  • Relevante Zertifizierungen, beispielsweise Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Red Hat, VMware oder HashiCorp.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine spannende und vielseitige Arbeitsumgebung mit herausfordernden Projekten.
  • Die Möglichkeit, Produkte zu gestalten, die echten Mehrwert für Unternehmen und Nutzer schaffen.
  • Ein agiles Umfeld, das Innovation und Kreativität fördert.
  • Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes und wachsendes Team, das gemeinsam vorwärtsgeht.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Creo Center is a Nordic product development partner with operations in Finland and Sweden, helping both local and international organizations create and develop innovations across different industries. We have strong interest in new techniques and innovative solutions, with our clients primarily consisting of international R&D companies, manufacturing firms, or startups with innovative product ideas. United by our passion for product development, we help our clients turn ideas into success.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior R&D Engineer to join our team!

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop mechanical systems, components, and assemblies for advanced technology products

* Create detailed 3D models and manufacturing documentation using Siemens NX

* Manage product data and engineering documentation in Teamcenter

* Support prototype builds, testing activities, and product validation collaborating with different suppliers

* Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, quality requirements, and safety regulations

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related technical field

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in mechanical engineering within engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, or high-tech industries

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

* Extensive hands-on experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter

* Fluent communication skills in both English and Finnish

* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams

* Willingness to work on-site in the Western Uusimaa region

* Flexibility and willingness to travel within Southern Finland, particularly to supplier and manufacturing sites

Preferred Qualifications:

* Knowledge of semiconductor, vacuum process, precision equipment, or similar high-technology industries

* Familiarity with ASME and related industrial standards

Why Creo Center?

At Creo Center, you'll join a community of over 160 product development professionals, where expertise thrives and grows through multidisciplinary collaboration. Our network of experienced colleagues and diverse customer base across multiple industries provide continuous opportunities for learning, professional growth, and the development of new expertise. We support your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package that includes a lunch benefit, mobile phone benefit, commuter benefit or company bike benefit, extended occupational healthcare, and comprehensive leisure-time accident insurance. We believe in shared success, which is why every year we distribute a portion of our operating profit among all employees through our People Bonus program.

Join us!

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 11.10.2026. This position is permanent and full-time, with the start date to be agreed upon.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact R&D Unit Manager Benjamin Ekström +358 41 507 7201 on weekdays.

jobs.description:
Description de tâches:
Nous sommes aujourd'hui l'un des plus grands employeurs du Grand-Duché et comptons parmi les recruteurs les plus actifs. Attentifs aux besoins de notre Groupe, comme de ceux de nos employés et employées, nous recrutons, intégrons et accompagnons chaque année plusieurs dizaines de nouveaux collaborateurs et collaboratrices de tous horizons, de tous profils. L'expansion de nos activités nous pousse à la recherche incessante de nouveaux talents qui, tous ensemble, nourrissent la diversité de notre grande famille CFL.

Notre Service Maintenance Infrastructure se propose d'engager, pour une entrée au 1er avril 2027, des

AGENTS / AGENTES DE MAINTENANCE

Ce poste est à pourvoir à temps plein.

L'embauche est définitive à la suite d'une période de stage rémunérée de 1 an, comprenant des formations et des évaluations.

Votre mission :

* Vous assurez la réalisation de travaux d'entretien et de maintenance des voies ferrées et des alentours
* Vous travaillez sous la surveillance et la responsabilité de votre responsable qui vous transmet des instructions claires et exécutez les travaux qui vous ont été assignés de façon appropriée
* Vous réalisez des travaux de maintenance et d'entretien des voies et appareils de voie (rails, traverses, aiguillages, accès, voies et passages à niveau), maintenance des pistes et curage des évacuations d'eau
* Vous effectuez pendant la période hivernale des travaux d'élagage, de débroussaillage et de taille des haies aux alentours des voies ferrées
* Vous participez aux actions de déneigement et de salage des accès aux gares et sur les quais
* Vous vous occupez de la manutention des machines d'entretien

Votre profil :

* Vous avez au minimum accompli la scolarité obligatoire
* Vous maîtrisez les langues allemande et française aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, et le luxembourgeois à l'oral
* Vous remplissez les conditions d'aptitude physique suivantes :

o bonne acuité auditive

o bonne vision des couleurs

o bonne mobilité physique sur terrain inégal

o port de charges lourdes

* Vous acceptez de suivre des instructions et des procédures
* Vous avez un sens développé des responsabilités et un esprit de sécurité
* Vous avez un bon esprit d'équipe et d'initiative
* Vous êtes de nature dynamique, polyvalente et rigoureuse
* Vous acceptez de travailler à l'extérieur par tous les temps
* Vous êtes flexible pour travailler les week-ends, les jours fériés et la nuit en fonction des travaux prévus
* Vous acceptez de faire des astreintes
* Vous êtes titulaire du permis de conduire B
* Vous avez la nationalité d'un pays membre de l'Union européenne.

À la recherche d'un nouveau défi professionnel ?

Votre recruteuse, Caroline FELGEN reste à votre entière disposition par e-mail pour tout renseignement complémentaire :



Vos obligations administratives :

* Une preuve de l'intégralité de vos activités professionnelles passées (certificat de travail, certificat d'affiliation, relevé de carrière, etc.) devra être fournie au cours du processus de recrutement. Ces documents devront être fournis sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.
* Un extrait de votre casier judiciaire luxembourgeois (bulletin numéro 3 et éventuellement numéro 4), - ainsi que de votre pays de résidence si vous ne résidez pas au Luxembourg - datant de moins de 3 mois sera également à fournir sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.

Envie de découvrir les CFL de l'intérieur ?

Découvrez notre blog dédié à nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, à leurs métiers et leurs passions : www.WEARECFL.lu

Le Groupe CFL, employeur de l'égalité des chances

Au sein du Groupe CFL, nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. Nous œuvrons pour un environnement de travail respectueux et adapté, où la diversité prend racine et où l'inclusion est la norme, car nous savons que le sentiment d'unité permet à chacun et chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel.

jobs.title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
jobs.description:
International Tax Senior Advisor

locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.
We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.

The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.title: Second de cuisine (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

DESCRIPTIF DE POSTE
SECOND DE CUISINE – grand café

SUPERIEUR HIERARCHIQUE : chef de cuisine

ENCADREMENT : OUI

MISSION PRINCIPALE:

Le second de cuisine est chargé de seconder le chef de cuisine dans la gestion opérationnelle de la cuisine du restaurant GRAND CAFE. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec lui dans le but d'assurer une production culinaire de haute qualité et de satisfaire les attentes des clients. Il est également responsable de la supervision d'une équipe composée de chefs de partie, de commis et plongeurs, tout en garantissant le respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire.

TACHES ET RESPONSABILITES:

Management:

• Il assiste le chef dans la planification et l'organisation de l'ensemble des activités quotidiennes de la cuisine
• Il supervise les chefs de partie et les commis afin d'assurer une production culinaire professionnelle et constante
• Il motive, encourage et donne le rythme à l'équipe lors du service
• Il participe activement à la formation et au suivi des membres de l'équipe, en transmettant son savoir-faire et en favorisant leur développement professionnel

Mise en place:

• Il contrôle la propreté de la cuisine et des frigos, en cas de non-respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité il en réfère au personnel de cuisine
• Il organise les tâches du personnel de cuisine de manière détaillée en fonction de la fiche de mise en place établie
• Il allume les fours
• Il se tient informé auprès du maitre d'hôtel du nombre de réservations pour anticiper le service à venir et l'informe de changements éventuels de carte, de portions limitées, de recommandations particulières à faire aux clients
• Il contrôle que chaque chef de partie a bien suivi sa fiche de mise en place à chaque début de service et qu'il l'a bien remplie en fin de service

Production:

• Il participe, et est force de proposition dans l'élaboration des menus, plats et fiches techniques
• Il redirige les commandes clients et leurs envois vers les différentes parties
• Il contrôle l'application de toutes les directives concernant la fabrication des plats, leur qualité et leur présentation
• Il corrige les erreurs de préparation et de présentation avant que les plats ne soient envoyés
• Il organise et contrôle l'envoi des suites de plats
• Il maintient une communication régulière avec les autres départements du restaurant, notamment le service en salle, pour garantir une coordination optimale

Hygiène – approvisionnement:

• Il applique et veille au bon respect des règles d'hygiène de sécurité alimentaire quotidiennement
• Il contrôle la propreté de l'ensemble de la cuisine : plonge, plans de travail, ustensiles, machines, sols, frigos...
• Il réceptionne les marchandises, contrôle leur température, s'assure qu'elles soient conformes aux commandes passées et les range
• Il vérifie que chaque production du jour soit étiquetée
• Il relève quotidiennement la température des frigos et contrôle les DLC en veillant à la bonne rotation des produits selon FIFO
• Il contrôle les stocks, en veillant à minimiser les pertes et le gaspillage, il effectue les commandes nécessaires auprès des fournisseurs


PREREQUIS:

• Avoir d'excellente connaissance des techniques de cuisine et méthodes de préparation
• Être doté de capacités managériales développées, une aptitude à encadrer et à motiver son équipe
• Avoir une communication claire et efficace
• Avoir un sens aigu de l'organisation, de la planification et de la gestion des priorités
• Être orienté résultats, capable de travailler efficacement dans un environnement sous pression
• Connaitre les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire

Remarque:  Travail le soir possible jusqu'à 00h00

Autres compétences requises:  5 ans dans un poste identique
