From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Strategic Finance Business Partner to support our AI team and other business functions. Our Strategic Finance Business Partnership team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, driving our financial planning, forecasting, and review processes, and guiding critical decisions through insightful analyses and strategic thought partnership.

This is a high-impact role on a lean team: you’ll partner deeply across Engineering and Product to strengthen executive-level visibility into financial performance, improve forecast accuracy, and evaluate strategic investments across our product.

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Embed deeply within the AI team and broader business as a trusted financial partner. Understand key cost drivers and the product roadmap to proactively surface financial implications, risks, and opportunities.

 - Own weekly and monthly AI cost reporting end to end, delivering clear visibility into spend, usage, key trends, and anomalies for executives and functional leaders.

 - Deliver thoughtful analyses to support strategic decisions with strong judgment, speed, and attention to detail.

 - Support the monthly close and reporting process with Accounting, vendor and PO tracking, budget-versus-actuals cost analyses, and flux reviews

 - Partner with the AI team, Product, Data Science, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver accurate forecasts and budgets.

 - Strengthen AI cost data and reporting infrastructure by identifying data gaps, improving recurring workflows, and using AI and automation to make reporting more durable, scalable, and timely.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2-4 years of experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, and/or Corporate Finance

 - Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, financial close, and reporting (budget vs. actuals, etc.)

 - Data fluency and the ability to navigate complex datasets, including identifying anomalies or data gaps.

 - Intellectual curiosity, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to move from detailed data to a clear point of view on performance, risks, and opportunities

 - Comfortable partnering directly with senior leadership and building strong cross-functional relationships

 - Strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail — “get it done” attitude

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with a high-growth tech company, including native AI, SaaS, or consumption-based businesses

jobs.title: Global Head of Land Revenue
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll build and run the global operating system that drives Land: the strategy, programs, and operating mechanisms that create net-new and upgrade iARR across regions.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Partner with SC leadership and practice owners to ensure the Land-side SC motion has standard plays, discovery patterns, demo and problem-solving expectations, certification paths, ramp mechanisms, and ongoing bar-raising rituals

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Senior GTM leadership experience owning new business acquisition programs at scale across multiple regions

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and help customers achieve better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer - West
Enterprise Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. Youâll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If youâre a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptalâs perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptalâs vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptalâs impact on the worldâs largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptalâs partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelorâs degree is required.
  • 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. Weâre not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Offre d'emploi Responsable des Opérations Commerciales (h/f/*) Philips Medical Capital, situé à Paris - La Défense Philips Medical Capital (PMC) Europe dispose de deux coentreprises en France et en Allemagne, ainsi qu'entre la société BPCE ES (GEFA Bank GmbH en Allemagne) et Philips, en plus de plusieurs accords de distribution locaux supplémentaires, qui offrent une large gamme de solutions de financement pour les clients de Philips. PMC soutient Philips Healthcare depuis plus de 20 ans ; les solutions de financement proposées sous la marque PMC soutiennent les ventes et contribuent à renforcer notre positionnement sur différents marchés à travers le monde. Ces solutions de financement vont du crédit-bail standard / location avec services complets ou de la location-vente à la structuration financière de services d'équipements gérés et d'appels d'offres publics. En plus du crédit-bail traditionnel, nos clients recherchent de plus en plus des approches différentes qui impliquent généralement un champ de services plus large et un engagement à long terme. PMC évolue dans un environnement hautement dynamique où il est essentiel de placer le client au centre des préoccupations et de proposer des solutions complètes en collaboration avec notre partenaire distributeur, Philips. Philips Medical Care recherche un Responsable des Opérations Commerciales (h/f/*). Nous vous recherchons ! Êtes-vous un Spécialiste de l'Excellence Commerciale (h/f/*) dans le secteur financier ? Êtes-vous passionné par la gestion d'actifs et les processus d'opérations commerciales ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Vos responsabilités : Gestion d'actifs PMC : Développement et gestion des opérations européennes de gestion d'actifs de PMC, y compris la gestion de fin de contrat de location et la gestion de la valeur résiduelle. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager DSAR Process Transformation
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager for our client in the media sector.

Role Description:
The client is currently looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and scoping of the automation of our GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) process. The current process is largely manual and involves multiple teams, systems and data owners. The objective of the assignment is to deliver an approved and actionable plan for future automation, including a documented current-state and gap analysis, aligned Privacy requirements, a governance model and a phased roadmap for technical implementation. The aim is to implement technical automation of the GDPR process starting from next year.

The DSAR process has an established process owner who owns the process and related business decisions. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. Team size of 15-20 people.

Responsibilities:
· Lead the planning, coordination and overall delivery of the DSAR automation planning project
· Define and maintain project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines
· Coordinate the mapping and documentation of the current DSAR process across relevant teams, systems and data sources
· Coordinate the identification of process, compliance, governance and technical gaps together with the process owner and subject-matter experts
· Identify and track open questions, risks, dependencies, blockers and required decisions
· Support the process owner and privacy stakeholders in aligning and documenting privacy requirements and required risk decisions
· Coordinate the definition of the future-state process, governance model, roles and responsibilities
· Coordinate technical stakeholders in identifying automation opportunities, integration needs and technical dependencies
· Ensure agreed business, process and privacy requirements are translated into a clear scope for future technical implementation
· Develop a prioritised and phased roadmap for the technical automation build together with technical stakeholders
· Prepare status reporting, recommendations and decision material for management

Expected Deliverables:
· Current-state process map and scope document
· Gap analysis (process, compliance, governance, technical)
· Documented Privacy requirements and risk decisions
· Governance model with defined roles and responsibilities (e.g. RACI)
· Prioritised, phased automation roadmap
· Approved plan with agreed next steps for implementation

Skills and Qualifications:
· Strong experience leading complex cross-functional transformation, regulatory or technology projects
· Strong project management skills
· Previous experience and knowledge of GDPR, privacy programmes, DSAR/DSR processes or other regulatory processes
· Experience with process or workflow automation
· Experience with enterprise data landscapes involving multiple systems and data owners
· Proven ability to structure ambiguous and fragmented problem areas into clear scope, decisions and deliverables
· Experience coordinating work across business and technical stakeholders
· Experience with current-state assessments, gap analyses and roadmap development
· Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills
· Experience managing project risks, dependencies and competing priorities
· Ability to prepare clear management-level recommendations and decision material

1. Have you led a GDPR, privacy, or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) transformation project from planning through implementation?

3. Have you conducted current-state assessments and gap analyses covering process, governance, compliance, and technology areas?
4. Have you planned or delivered workflow/process automation initiatives involving multiple systems and data owners?
5. Have you created and presented governance models, implementation roadmaps, and decision materials to senior leadership or steering committees?

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE


We’re seeking our first Head of Corporate Development hire to build and own the function, driving acquisition strategy and end-to-end execution to accelerate Replit’s core capabilities. You’ll build and run Replit’s acquisition pipeline, identifying the teams and technologies that can accelerate our mission. You’ll develop a deep understanding of the AI, developer tools, and software infrastructure ecosystem. You’ll build relationships with founders, investors, and industry participants to source and evaluate mergers & acquisitions.

This is a hands-on ownership role for someone who combines strong transaction execution skills with product judgment, relationship-building ability, and the ability to drive complex decisions across teams. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, AI, Engineering, People and Legal. The role reports to the Head of Finance, but partners very closely with our Co-Founder & CEO and President & Head of AI.



What You’ll Do

 - Develop relationships: Establish trusted relationships with founders, investors, bankers, operators, and other participants across the ecosystem. Identify and attend industry events to source M&A opportunities.

Partner with Product, AI, and Engineering leaders to assess build, buy, and partner alternatives and deliver clear go/no-go recommendations.

Lead valuation and financial modeling, structure transactions, drive cross-functional due diligence, and lead negotiations in partnership with executive sponsors and Legal. Be accountable for the deal workplan, timelines, risk escalation, and decision materials. Coordinate integration planning with functional leaders, establishing clear owners and success measures before close.



Required Skills and Experience

 - Strong product & technological intuition.

 - High degree of ownership, curiosity, and comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

jobs.description:

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because this could be the position for you!

**We are looking for** a practice assistant to join White & Case's team in a full-time, permanent position. Key tasks in this role include assisting lawyers with client-related work, along with other tasks to ensure that the daily operations run smoothly at the office. As a practice assistant, you will join a dynamic team of 45 professionals in the Helsinki office.

**In this role,** you will provide assistance across all practice groups. Your responsibilities include a wide range of administrative tasks, such as assisting lawyers with editing and formatting legal documentation, conducting research, providing translation support, as well as preparing and maintaining transaction data rooms. In addition, your duties include liaising with clients, various governmental authorities as well as White & Case's global offices. As a practice assistant, you are also ready to provide support with meeting arrangements, calendar management and other back-office duties.

**You will join** an efficient team of four practice assistants as the fifth member of the team and share your daily work with three evening assistants, a reception assistant and a senior practice assistant. White & Case's team works mainly on-site at their office in the heart of Helsinki, with the flexibility to work remotely once a week during most weeks.

- have at least one year of experience in a legal assistant or an administrative assistant role within a professional services organization, ideally in a law firm, consulting firm or financial institution;

- have a suitable educational background, such as a Bachelor of Business Administration degree;

- are highly organized and demonstrate great attention to detail;

- enjoy taking initiative and working independently while valuing teamwork and supporting your colleagues;

- are skilled in managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high quality in your work;

- have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and oral communication skills in Finnish and English; and

- are proficient in MS Office programs (especially Word) and able to quickly learn new software and systems.


**White & Case offers you:**

- an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment within a highly regarded international law firm;

- a diverse, key support role where you will also have the opportunity to assist lawyers with client assignments;

- a close-knit work community that invests in the development of each team member; and

- comprehensive benefits, including extensive occupational healthcare, optional health and accident insurance, and internal training opportunities to support your development. In addition, White & Case offers a selection of alternative benefits, which can be used, for example, for dental care, eyeglasses, a public transport pass, cultural activities or sports.

We encourage you to apply early, as we will start reviewing applications already during the application period. If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjons recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

White & Case operates on a one firm basis, which is present in the day-to-day work of its professionals. They advise multinational corporates, financial institutions and private equity firms on corporate and financing transactions across all major industry sectors. White & Case's core practice areas in Finland are Capital Markets, Debt Finance and M&A/Private Equity._

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the worldâs largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptalâs value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptalâs full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the clientâs concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the clientâs needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptalâs service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptalâs model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the clientâs need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2â3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology â MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk â and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a clientâs thinking when their stated request isnât the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isnât the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
La bonne compétence, au bon endroit, au bon moment.

Chez Potentiel Humain, ce n'est pas qu'un slogan, c'est une façon de travailler.

Cabinet de conseil en compétences, nous accompagnons les entreprises de Montpellier, Nîmes, Béziers et Perpignan dans leurs enjeux humains et stratégiques.

Nos expertises :

- Recrutement CDI / CDD / Intérim
- Management de transition / Temps partagé / Freelancing
- Formation sur mesure

Nous recrutons pour notre client, un hôtel situé au cœur du village naturiste du Cap d'Agde, un Directeur d'Hôtel H/F.

Caractéristiques :

- Type de contrat : CDD saisonnier
- Durée : de mars à fin octobre 2027
- Lieu de mission : Cap d'Agde
- Démarrage : mars 2027
- Base horaire : 6 jours sur 7, de 9h à 19h lorsque l'hôtel est ouvert ; 5 jours sur 7 lorsque l'hôtel est fermé
- Rémunération proposée : 3 846 € brut mensuel
- Statut : Cadre

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous aurez la responsabilité du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement et de la qualité de l'expérience proposée aux clients.

Vous aurez pour principales missions :

- Piloter l'ouverture et la fermeture saisonnières de l'hôtel : préparation des chambres, anticipation des besoins, gestion des stocks et coordination des opérations nécessaires au démarrage et à la fin de saison.
- Superviser l'exploitation quotidienne : contrôle de la qualité et de la propreté des chambres, suivi du linge, des consommables, du bar, du snacking et des produits d'entretien.
- Assurer le suivi administratif et financier courant : contrôle des facturations, clôtures journalières dans le logiciel hôtelier, vérification de la caisse et des tickets, traitement des remboursements si nécessaire et suivi des fournisseurs.
- Organiser l'activité et manager les équipes : optimisation du planning et de l'occupation des chambres, recrutement et suivi de l'équipe de ménage, coordination des différents intervenants et renfort opérationnel lors des pics d'activité.
- Garantir une expérience client de qualité : superviser l'accueil et le service, être attentif aux attentes de la clientèle et personnaliser la relation avec les clients fidèles.
- Coordonner les prestataires et préparer les saisons suivantes : suivi des interventions et travaux, gestion des services complémentaires en haute saison, suivi des réservations, des mails et du courrier hors période d'ouverture.

Polyvalent(e) et présent(e) sur le terrain, vous pourrez également renforcer ponctuellement les équipes, notamment à la réception, au bar ou sur l'activité snacking, lorsque l'activité le nécessite.

Comment notre client vous imagine ?

Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 10 ans minimum sur un poste similaire dans l'hôtellerie et maîtrisez les différents enjeux liés au fonctionnement quotidien d'un établissement.

Votre anglais vous permet d'échanger avec aisance avec une clientèle internationale, aussi bien à l'oral que dans les échanges professionnels courants.

Manager de terrain, vous savez organiser l'activité, encadrer une équipe et prendre des décisions tout en restant disponible pour intervenir opérationnellement lorsque la situation le demande.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre sens du service, votre organisation, votre fiabilité et votre réactivité. À l'aise dans la relation client, vous savez vous adapter à une clientèle exigeante et instaurer une relation professionnelle et personnalisée.

Votre polyvalence constitue un véritable atout : gestion administrative, suivi des prestataires, organisation des équipes, contrôle des chambres ou soutien aux différents services font partie d'un quotidien que vous appréciez.

Enfin, vous disposez d'un réel sens commercial et savez identifier les attentes des clients afin de leur proposer un service adapté.

jobs.title: Ingénieur de production DEVOPS (H/F)
jobs.employer: UCC EXPERTS UNIFIED COMMUNICATION AND CO
jobs.description:
Ingénieur DevOps Cloud / Kubernetes (H/F)
1. Contexte du Poste & Enjeux à Toulouse
Expérience requise : 9 ans minimum (profil Senior / Expert).
Localisation : Toulouse et agglomération (Blagnac, Labège, etc.).

Contexte local :
Missions Principales
Architecture & Design de Plateformes Cloud : Concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les architectures Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP ou Cloud Souverain) et on-premise hautement disponibles, scalables et sécurisées.
Stratégie Kubernetes & Containerisation : Définir la stratégie de conteneurisation globale de l'entreprise, industrialiser le déploiement des clusters Kubernetes à grande échelle et garantir leur résilience.
Industrialisation & Automatisation (CI/CD) : Concevoir les pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) les plus optimisés possibles pour automatiser le cycle de vie applicatif du code à la production.
FinOps & Performance : Optimiser les coûts d'infrastructure Cloud (démarche FinOps) et veiller aux performances globales des environnements.

Leadership Technique & Culture DevOps : Porter la culture DevOps/DevSecOps au sein des équipes, évangéliser les bonnes pratiques, rédiger les standards d'architecture et mentorer les ingénieurs juniors/seniors.

3. Compétences Techniques Détaillées (Hard Skills)
A. Containerisation & Écosystème Kubernetes (Expertise Majeure)
Orchestration : Maîtrise approfondie de Kubernetes (architecture des control planes, etcd, kube-proxy, CNI, CSI). Expérience sur les managed clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE) et on-premise (Rancher, OpenShift, k3s).

Networking & Service Mesh : Configuration des CNI (Calico, Cilium, Flannel), gestion des Ingress Controllers (NGINX, Traefik) et mise en place de Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) pour la gestion du trafic inter-services.

Stockage & Stateful : Gestion des volumes persistant (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook/Ceph, NFS).

Package Management : Maîtrise de Helm pour le templating et le packaging d'applications.

B. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Providers
Cloud Publics : Maîtrise avancée d'au moins un grand Cloud provider (AWS ou Azure / GCP), ou des environnements OpenStack / VMware pour les contextes on-premise/privés.

IaC & Provisioning : Maîtrise absolue de Terraform / OpenTofu (gestion d'état, modules, remote state) et Ansible pour la configuration.

Immutable Infrastructure : Utilisation d'outils comme Packer pour la génération d'images de VM/conteneurs.

C. CI/CD & Automatisation du Software Delivery
Pipelines CI/CD : Conception de chaînes d'intégration complexes avec GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD ou Jenkins.

GitOps : Implémentation de paradigmes GitOps avec ArgoCD ou FluxCD pour synchroniser l'état des clusters Kubernetes avec les repositories Git.

D. Observabilité, Monitoring & SRE
Supervision & Métriques : Déploiement et administration de Prometheus, Thanos, Cortex, et design de dashboards sur Grafana.

Centralisation des Logs & Tracing : Maîtrise des stacks d'observabilité (ELK / EFK, Grafana Loki, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry).

Fiabilité (SRE) : Définition des SLO, SLA et SLI, gestion des alertes et automatisation de la remédiation (incident response).

E. Sécurité (DevSecOps) & Compliance
Software Supply Chain Security : Analyse de vulnérabilités des images (Trivy, Clair), signature d'images (Cosign), SBOM (Software Bill of Materials).

jobs.title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

- kampanjoiden, webinaarien, messujen ja asiakastilaisuuksien suunnittelu ja toteutus

- verkkosivujen, SEO:n ja AI-haun kehittäminen

- markkinointimateriaalien ja landing pagejen rakentaminen

- analytiikan, liidien ja eri kanavien tulosten seuranta

- markkinoinnin työkalujen ja tekoälyn aktiivinen hyödyntäminen.


Hyvä sisältö ei ole meille itseisarvo. Sen pitää rakentaa tunnettavuuutta, herättää kiinnostusta, vahvistaa asiantuntijabrändiä, synnyttää liidejä ja tukea myyntiä.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme kokenutta B2B-markkinoijaa, jolla on jo näyttöjä siitä, mitä on omalla osaamisellaan saavuttanut.

Toivomme sinulta:

- vahvaa kokemusta B2B-markkinoinnista

- vahvaa sisältömarkkinoinnin ja kirjoittamisen osaamista

- erittäin hyvää LinkedIn- ja Instagram-osaamista

- kokemusta tapahtumista, webinaareista ja kampanjoista

- ymmärrystä SEO:sta, verkkosivuista, analytiikasta ja liidien muodostumisesta

- hyvää visuaalista silmää

- vahvaa markkinoinnin työkalujen tuntemusta

- kykyä hyödyntää tekoälyä tehokkaasti omassa työssäsi

- erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen osaamista. Aiemmin kokemus kansainvälisiltä markkinoilta on vahva etu.


**Aikaisempi kokemus kasvuyrityksestä sekä SaaS-, teknologia-, asiantuntija- tai ratkaisumyynnin markkinoinnista on meille erittäin tärkeää.** Ja jos tiedät ja osaat selkeästi perustella, että markkinoinnin onnistuminen näkyy muuallakin kuin seuraajamäärässä, saat meiltä monta tykkäystä.

**Millainen henkilö menestyy meillä?**

Menestyt tässä roolissa, jos olet samaan aikaan luova, kaupallinen ja systemaattinen. Tartut asioihin itsenäisesti, viet ideat käytäntöön ja osaat muuttaa suuntaa nopeasti, jos data kertoo, ettei jokin toimi.

Pidät ihmisistä, tapahtumista ja keskusteluista ja saat mielellään asiantuntijasta irti ajatuksen, jota hän ei itse edes tajunnut olevan julkaisemisen arvoinen (big ask, we know ). Uskallat myös haastaa tiiminjäseniä! Huonot ideat nostetaan rohkeasti pöytään ja tehdään niistä yhdessä parempia.

Kasvuyrityksessä kaikki ei ole valmiiksi pureskeltua. Jos tarvitset täydellisen tehtävänannon, kolmen viikon hyväksyntäkierroksen ja kuusi allekirjoitusta ennen julkaisua, emme ehkä ole täydellinen match.

Jos taas nautit siitä, että pääset rakentamaan, kokeilemaan ja näkemään oman kädenjälkesi nopeasti, hae meille!

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Saat laajan roolin kasvuyrityksessä, jossa markkinointi on yksi kasvun tärkeimmistä moottoreista.

Pääset työskentelemään suoraan omistajien, asiantuntijoiden, myynnin ja teknologiatiimin kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Vire Advisors ja Arviro näyttävät ja kuulostavat seuraavassa kasvuvaiheessaan.

Saat vastuuta, vapautta ja tilaa tehdä asioita paremmin kuin me olemme niitä tähän asti tehneet. Itse asiassa sitä me sinulta odotammekin.

**Työpaikka:** Vire Advisors

**Tehtävänimike:** Senior Marketing & Growth Specialist

**Työsuhde:** Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, se voi myös olla osa-aikainen ja/tai toiminimiyrittäjä. Olemme avoimia monenlaisille työsuhdemuodoille, kunhan osaaminen ja omistautuneisuus ovat kohdallaan.

**Sijainti / hybridityö:** Vire Advisors on tällä hetkellä 100% remote. Ainakin toistaiseksi. Ehdotuksia otetaan vastaan.

**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovittavissa. Meidän monilahjakas markkinoinnin assistentti Sanna päättää määräaikaisuutensa 16.10.2026.

**Hakuaika:** Än, yy, tee, nyt! Hakuaika alkaa nyt, ja päättyy viimeistään 23.10.2026

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille CV ja kerro erityisesti siitä, mistä olet oman osaamisesi suhteen ylpeä, mitä onnistumisia haluat tuoda esiin. Voit mielellään näyttää meille sisältöjä, kampanjoita, tapahtumia tai muita kokonaisuuksia, joista olet ylpeä ja jotka mielestäsi tukevat hakemustasi.

**Meitä kiinnostaa vähemmän se, mistä olet ollut vastuussa. Meitä kiinnostaa enemmän se, mitä sinun ansiostasi tapahtui.**

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.description:

Facilities Manager Location: Dublin 7, Ireland Salary: €50,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role Sodexo is looking for an experienced Facilities Manager to join our team in Grangegorman. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for the day-to-day management of the on-site hard and soft services team, ensuring excellent service delivery, strong operational performance and compliance with contractual requirements. You’ll play a key role in managing the site team, contractors, maintenance programmes, lifecycle works and reactive client requirements, while driving continuous improvement across the contract. What You’ll Be Doing Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft FM services. Lead, support and develop the on-site service delivery team. Manage planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and lifecycle programmes. Coordinate reactive works and ensure client requirements are delivered effectively. Scope and verify minor works. Manage the SSOW permitting system and promote safe working practices. Lead Toolbox Talks, Safety Walks and Near Miss reporting. Manage contractor engagement and site inductions. Act as the key operational point of contact for on-site issues. Manage materials ordering and maintain accurate contract and project records. Deliver allocated projects on time, within budget and to specification. Monitor remedial works, budgets and expenditure. Support continuous improvement, innovation and cost-reduction initiatives. Build strong relationships with clients, visitors, contractors and internal stakeholders. Prepare reports and monitor operational deadlines and performance. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for an experienced Facilities professional who combines strong people leadership with commercial awareness and excellent customer service. You’ll ideally have: Previous FM management or coordination experience. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience in a client-facing role. Good understanding of FM technical services. Experience working with contracts and commercial requirements. Strong financial and budget management skills. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. The ability to analyse information, make decisions and provide practical solutions. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel. A customer-focused and solutions-oriented approach. The ability to work at pace while maintaining accuracy.
