jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til automatisering og forretningsudvikling
jobs.description:
Bliv driftschefens højre hånd hos Holstebro Vægtservice.

Vi har vejet Danmark siden 1977, alt fra fisk til fyldte lastbiler. Nu bygger vi virksomheden op på ny: mere digital, mere struktureret og klar til vækst. 

Til det søger vi en studerende, der vil arbejde tæt sammen med driftschefen om at udvikle forretningen. Vejen fra idé til handling er kort, og ansvaret er større, end studenterjobs normalt byder på. Du er også velkommen til at bruge HOVA som case i dit semesterprojekt, bachelor eller speciale.

Det praktiske

8 til 15 timer om ugen, tilpasset dit semester. Timeløn efter kvalifikationer.

Forventet start hurtigst muligt. Typisk 1 til 2 faste dage i Holstebro, resten aftaler vi, når du kender dit skema. Vi ligger cirka 30 minutter fra Herning ad motorvejen.

Din første opgave

Når du er sat ind i virksomheden, bliver din første opgave at undersøge, hvordan vi kan effektivisere og måske automatisere processen omkring salg af labels til kunder. Herfra er du med til selv at pege på, hvilke processer vi lettest kan effektivisere og få mest værdi ud af.

Opgaverne

  • Udvikle webshop og hjemmeside: oprette produkter, forbedre indhold og skabe mersalg

  • Producere SoMe-indhold, der viser, hvad vi laver

  • Drive igangsatte initiativer helt i mål

  • Undersøge og præsentere processer og struktur, så forretningen kan skalere

  • Teste og bygge automatiseringer med AI, Make eller N8N, og finde ud af, hvad der faktisk virker


I starten fokuserer vi mest på de tre første, men løbende udvikles dit ansvarsområde, som du starter og udvikler dig.

Du kommer også med teknikerne ud til kunderne for at se hvad vi laver og giver en hånd på værkstedet, når fx. ordrer skal pakkes. 

Hvem er du?

  • Du læser fx BDE eller ITKO i Herning, eller noget der ligner

  • Du er nysgerrig og arbejdsom, og du får ting færdige, ikke kun startet

  • Du tør træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem

  • Du behøver ikke kunne kode, men AI skal vække din nysgerrighed. Kender du Make eller N8N, er det et plus

  • Du behøver ikke vide noget om vægte. Det kommer.

Det får du

  • Reelt ansvar: egne projekter og direkte samarbejde med driftschefen. Dine beslutninger kan ses i forretningen, ikke i et slidedeck

  • Fleksible timer: timetallet følger dit semester, og der er plads til at skrue ned op til eksamen

  • HOVA som case: brug os i semesterprojekter, bachelor eller speciale

  • Læring på tværs: strategi, drift, salg, marketing og teknik i samme uge

  • En arbejdsplads, ikke kun en skærm: opgaverne løses primært hos os i Holstebro, men fleksibilitet er en nøgleværdi, og vi finder en model, der passer med dit studie

Hvorfor Holstebro Vægtservice?

Vi er et lille team, og i dag en del af VF Stålindustri. Vores kunder spænder fra
fiskeindustri og landbrug til produktion, og fælles for dem er, at intet må veje forkert. Vi står midt i en rigtig spændende periode i virksomhedens historie, og du kan være med til at forme den.

Sådan søger du

Send en motiveret ansøgning og dit CV til tu@hova.dk.
Ring til Tobias på +45 20 23 93 99 hvis du vil hører mere først. 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette er der.

jobs.title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

  • Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

  • Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

  • Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

  • Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

  • Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

  • Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

jobs.description:
Customized Portfolio Manager

locations Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)
time type Full time
job requisition id REQ-10121852

Your role & work environment

As a Customized Portfolio Manager, you are responsible for managing discretionary portfolios and dedicated funds in line with clients' needs, the investment strategy, and regulatory requirements. You actively contribute to investment decisions, portfolio construction, and client reporting.

You will be part of the Portfolio Management team, working closely with investment specialists, commercial teams, and external stakeholders to deliver tailored investment solutions and ensure high-quality portfolio management.

Your key responsibilities

Manage discretionary portfolios and dedicated funds

• Monitor discretionary accounts under your responsibility in a MiFID II environment and ensure compliance with investment rules, the investment universe, client profiles, investment decisions, and operational processes.
• Manage dedicated funds in full regulatory compliance and maintain regular coordination with the management company.
• Actively manage investment portfolios while monitoring financial markets and market developments.

Develop investment solutions and portfolio strategies

• Draft investment proposals for discretionary mandates in line with client needs and the ING Luxembourg investment charter.
• Contribute to the design and updating of model portfolios.
• Participate in sourcing new investment ideas and cross-asset investment solutions for customized portfolios.

Provide expertise and stakeholder support

• Prepare ad hoc and recurring reporting for clients under your responsibility and ensure transparent communication on portfolio strategy and results.
• Actively contribute to investment committees.
• Support the commercial force through presentations, training sessions, and investment expertise, with a strong focus on asset allocation and multi-asset solutions.

We look for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.

As a Customized Portfolio Manager you will also need:

• Master's degree with 5 to 7 years of experience in discretionary portfolio management (bank mandates, life insurance, or dedicated UCITS/AIF funds).
• Strong multi-asset knowledge and a solid understanding of macroeconomics.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex investment topics and support commercial teams.
• Fluent in French and English. Knowledge of Dutch, German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset.
• CFA designation is considered an asset.
• Team spirit, autonomy, and a proactive mindset.

We redefine banking. What about you?

There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centred around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that!

jobs.description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Finance Department for a:

Head of Regulatory Reporting - (CDI)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref: MIBLHRR_092026)

Responsibilities:

• Coordinate and manage all activities relating to the Regulatory Reporting function.
• Ensure the timely, accurate and complete preparation, review, and submission of all regulatory reports.
• Oversee the regulatory reporting calendar and ensure compliance with regulatory deadlines.
• Maintain appropriate governance, controls, reconciliations, validations, and escalation processes for regulatory reporting activities.
• Provide advice, management information and escalation on regulatory reporting matters, risks, and issues to the Head of Finance and General Management.
• Act as the primary contact for regulatory reporting matters with internal and external stakeholders.
• Manage FINREP reporting requirements for the CSSF and CBI.
• Manage prudential reporting under the applicable CRR framework, including COREP, LAREX, LCR, NSFR and other regulatory returns.
• Manage statistical reporting requirements to the Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL).
• Coordinate regulatory surveys, information requests and ad hoc reporting required by competent authorities.
• Participate in regulatory, system and Bank-wide projects impacting regulatory reporting requirements (OneSumX migration, IFRS 18 implementation, etc.).
• Coordinate testing, validation and implementation of new reporting requirements, system upgrades, and reporting solutions.
• Provide regulatory reporting expertise for system migrations, data mapping, testing, reconciliation, and validation activities
• Investigate and resolve reporting, calculation, and data quality issues with relevant stakeholders.
• Participate in the production of Regulatory reports.
• Assist the Head of Finance Department during the statutory audit of the Bank, by providing external auditors with the necessary supporting documents.
• Establish and maintain robust controls over reporting data, interfaces, and regulatory submissions.
• Coordinate corrective actions, report resubmissions and related regulatory communications where required.
• Maintain appropriate documentation, audit trails, policies, procedures and working instructions.
• Supervise and manage Regulatory Reporting staff.
• Conduct performance reviews and allocate responsibilities within the team.
• Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, knowledge transfer, and business continuity.
• Promote staff motivation, training, and professional development.

Qualifications:

• Master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Required Skills:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in banking regulatory reporting.
• Strong knowledge of FINREP, COREP, CRR/CRD, Basel, IFRS and EBA requirements.
• Good knowledge of CSSF, BCL and CBI reporting frameworks.
• Experience with regulatory reporting systems, preferably OneSumX/RRH.
• Experience in regulatory change, system implementation, and transformation projects.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
• People management and stakeholder management experience.
• Ability to work independently under tight deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to reporting accuracy.
• Fluent English, written and spoken. French is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

• French is an advantage.


If you are interested in taking up this opportunity, please send your application letter with detailed curriculum vitae to:

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology

- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment

jobs.title: Billing Coordinator (m/w/d) (Buchhalter/in)
jobs.description:

Wir sind die Kanzlei für die Welt von morgen. Als eine der dynamischsten internationalen Wirtschaftskanzleien in Deutschland leistet Osborne Clarke Mandatsarbeit auf höchstem Niveau. Deine Aufgabe

Als Billing Coordinator bist du eine zentrale Anlaufstelle im Bereich Revenue Control und sorgst dafür, dass die Abrechnung unserer Mandatsleistungen reibungslos, korrekt und effizient abläuft – für nationale wie internationale Mandanten gleichermaßen. Du arbeitest eng mit Partnern, Anwälten und Business-Services-Teams zusammen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Billing-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- Erstellung, Prüfung und Versand von Mandats- und Honorarrechnungen für nationale und internationale Mandanten
- Überwachung und Bearbeitung von Work-in-Progress (WIP), offenen Leistungen und abrechenbaren Positionen
- Abstimmung der Abrechnung mit Partnern, Anwälten und Business-Services-Teams
- Umsetzung individueller Billing Guidelines und mandantenspezifischer Abrechnungsvorgaben
- Prüfung von Auslagen, Fremdkosten, Vorschüssen und sonstigen abrechnungsrelevanten Positionen
- Bearbeitung von Korrekturrechnungen, Gutschriften und Stornierungen
- Unterstützung bei der Optimierung und Standardisierung von Billing-Prozessen
- Mitarbeit bei internen und externen Audits sowie bei Finance-Projekten

Du überzeugst durch

In dieser Rolle überzeugst du durch hohe Serviceorientierung, ausgeprägte Sorgfalt und ein gutes Verständnis für Abläufe in einer internationalen Wirtschaftskanzlei oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Dazu bringst du idealerweise folgendes mit:

- eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in einer Kanzlei oder in einer Professional Service Firm
- vorzugsweise einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung sowie Erfahrung mit der Erfassung, Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten
- den Anspruch, sorgfältig, strukturiert sowie eigenständig und proaktiv zu arbeiten
- eine professionelle Kommunikation nach innen und außen
- gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Kommunikation in einem internationalen Umfeld
- gute Kenntnisse in MS Office
- erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit 3e – ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Wir bieten dir

- eine spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe und eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit der Chance, in einer wachsenden Kanzlei sehr schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen
- eine langfristige, berufliche Perspektive in einer sich stets weiterentwickelnden modernen Wirtschaftskanzlei
- ein tolles standordübergreifendes Team mit flachen Hierarchien, gute Stimmung, viel Spaß an der Arbeit und genügend Raum deine eigenen Ideen einzubringen
- die Förderung und Unterstützung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung sowie immer ein offenes Ohr
- eine gute Work-Life-Balance, Zeit für deine persönlichen Belange und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in den Themen wie Diversity, Sustainability und Well-being-Angebote (Mobilitätsbudget, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, BAV, JobRad, Fitnessangebote, Dog Rules, Möglichkeit zum Mobile Working etc.) nicht nur Absichtserklärungen sind, sondern Daily Business
- zentral gelegene und gut angebundene, moderne Büros, aber auch die Möglichkeit zeitlich und örtlich flexibel zu arbeiten

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Osborne Clarke versteht sich als diverse Gesellschaft. Wir betrachten dies nicht nur als Floskel, sondern leben diese Einstellung jeden Tag. Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt und setzen uns für Integration am Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir stellen uns bewusst gegen jegliche Form der Diskriminierung und Belästigung aufgrund von Geschlecht & geschlechtlicher Identität

At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

We are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.
The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.
- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.

Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller

Das bringen Sie mit

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

jobs.title: Account Manager Executive (German - speaking) -  Remote work in Spain - HE04 (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”  

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer  

*We're proudly united as one team, one company, globally. We're committed to equal employment opportunities for all candidates and a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.*

jobs.title: Director Payment Integrity
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

 - Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

 - Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

 - Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners—not just recommendations.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

 - Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

 - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

 - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

 - Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing systems, including OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling.

 - Experience with cloud cost attribution, capacity planning, and provider coordination, particularly on GCP.

 - Experience growing distributed teams and using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Ads
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Help turn “I built a business” into “I have customers.” As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll help shape Agentic Ads: an emerging area focused on using AI to make customer acquisition more accessible to businesses built on Replit.

 

This role focuses on intelligent, advertiser-facing software—not ad-serving infrastructure, an ad exchange, or a real-time bidding engine. You’ll tackle problems at the intersection of AI, business growth, measurement, and trustworthy automation, turning complex decisions into clear, useful experiences.

 

You’ll help define a new product area, working closely with product, design, and engineering to discover customer needs and deliver practical solutions. This is a hands-on Staff role: you’ll own architecture, lead delivery across teams, mentor engineers, and turn an ambitious vision into incremental customer value.




YOU WILL:

 - Set technical direction for Agentic Ads, translating customer needs into an architecture and roadmap that balance rapid learning with long-term reliability.

 - Build agent-powered experiences that help businesses make informed growth decisions, translating user goals into understandable recommendations and appropriately authorized actions.

 - Design extensible integrations with external services, using well-defined APIs and abstractions that accommodate changing provider capabilities and requirements.

 - Partner with product and data teams to establish reliable measurement, connect product activity to business outcomes, and address data quality, delayed feedback, and uncertainty.

 - Develop intelligent automation that learns from performance signals and helps users improve outcomes within their goals and constraints.

 - Make financial control a product requirement: scoped authorization, explicit approvals, budget limits, auditable decisions, clear reporting, and reliable pause controls. Distinguish recommendations from actions that commit customer spend.

 - Make cross-platform workflows reliable with durable state, idempotency, safe retries, reconciliation, observability, and recovery from partial failures, expired credentials, rate limits, and provider API changes.

 - Establish agent evaluations and production monitoring for plan quality, tool selection, policy compliance, spend safety, and verified execution. Partner on experiments that distinguish attributed results from incremental customer value.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across product, design, AI, data, security, and partnerships. Stay hands-on with implementation, define incremental milestones, mentor engineers, and own the quality and operation of what the team ships.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms: setting direction, resolving ambiguity, and delivering through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on software engineering and system design skills across APIs, data modeling, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, and customer-facing product experiences.

 - Experience building and operating third-party integrations that remain correct under duplicate requests, partial failures, rate limits, changing schemas, and inconsistent external state.

 - Practical experience shipping LLM-powered products or agentic workflows, including tool use, orchestration, evaluations, and safeguards for actions taken against external systems.

 - Strong data and measurement judgment: experience using instrumentation and experiments to evaluate product outcomes, and the ability to reason about noisy data, delayed feedback, uncertainty, and correlation versus causation.

 - Sound judgment around systems that act on a user’s behalf, including authentication, authorization, sensitive data, approval boundaries, and limits on consequential actions.

 - Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams, explain technical trade-offs, mentor engineers, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - A product-minded approach to simplifying complex workflows for non-experts, with hands-on ownership from prototype through reliable production operation.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building advertiser-facing products, marketing automation, campaign-management tools, growth platforms, or software that helps businesses acquire customers.

 - Experience integrating advertising or marketing APIs; familiarity with account onboarding, campaign lifecycles, and platform requirements.

 - Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, budget pacing, and the limits of optimizing with low conversion volume.

 - Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, constrained optimization, recommendation systems, or decision-making under uncertainty.

 - Experience building permissioned, multi-tenant products with approval workflows, budget controls, audit trails, and privacy-aware handling of customer and conversion data.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with agent tooling, durable workflow execution, delegated authorization, or evaluation frameworks for agents that take consequential actions.

 - Experience connecting application events or server-side conversion signals to advertising platforms, or integrating creative generation and landing-page experimentation into growth workflows.

 - Experience building for small businesses or first-time advertisers, where clear guidance, limited budgets, and sparse data shape the product.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist. Experience with every ad platform is not expected; ad-serving infrastructure experience and an ML research background are not prerequisites.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means helping a business acquire qualified leads and customers—not merely connecting an account, launching a campaign, or increasing spend.

 - User control and trust: agents explain recommendations, act within explicit authority, and make budgets, costs, and consequential changes understandable.

 - Evidence over activity: we validate measurement, acknowledge uncertainty, and test whether a change improves business outcomes rather than treating attribution as proof of causality.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the journey from a business goal through campaign execution, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on existing ad platforms, ship focused increments, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.

jobs.title: KOMERCIJALIST/KOMERCIJALISTICA
jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti:

  • Savjetovanje i podrška: Putem telefona i e-maila savjetuješ tvrtke na francuskom tržištu – isključivo na francuskom jeziku – o tome kako najbolje iskoristiti našu platformu za preuzimanje visokokvalitetnih potencijalnih klijenata (leadova).
  • Analiza i rast prodaje: Analiziraš poslovne ciljeve klijenata, predlažeš optimalna rješenja unutar platforme i pratiš rezultate kako bi im osigurao/la kontinuiran rast prodaje.
  • Optimizacija rezultata: Redovito analiziraš uspješnost obrade leadova kod klijenata te pružaš strateške preporuke kako bi povećali stopu konverzije i ostvarili bolji povrat investicije.
  • Customer Support & Feedback: Brzo i profesionalno rješavaš sve upite, reklamacije i prijedloge klijenata, djelujući kao spona između njih i naše platforme.
  • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti:

  • Izvrsno znanje francuskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno razina C1) – s klijentima komuniciraš tečno i prirodno, na razini izvornog govornika, bez primjetnog naglaska
  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake
  • Organiziran/a si, voliš timski rad i motiviraju te jasni ciljevi

Što nudimo:

  • Strukturirani onboarding, kontinuirane edukacije i mentorstvo
  • Motivirajući bonusi povezani s rezultatima tima i portfelja
  • Ured s prijateljskom atmosferom i povremenim team building aktivnostima

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Tržište smo lansirali nedavno – sudjeluješ u izgradnji od samog početka, imaš priliku ostaviti svoj trag i rasti zajedno s platformom
  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan – radimo samo do 16 h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi u potpunosti napunio/la baterije.

jobs.description:
OPIS POSLOVA:

  • priprema dvorana i opreme potrebne za odvijanje događanja a sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • samostalno postavljanje opreme i ostvarivanje video programa te manjih ozvučenja, snimanja i reprodukcija u suradnji s vanjskim organizatorom i zaposlenicima Društva na terminima postave, pokusa i programa
  • samostalno postavljanje scenske i ambijentalne rasvjete sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika

  • prikupljanje i reproduciranje audio, video i svjetlosnog sadržaja sukladno zahtjevima i potrebama Društva i korisnika
  • osnovno održavanje, popravak i čišćenje postojeće i nove tonske i video opreme
  • rad na remontu postojeće cjelokupne instalacije slabe struje, kao i redovna briga o održavanju tonske, video i ostale elektroničke opreme u vlasništvu Društva
  • za vrijeme održavanja programa, rad u propisanoj odjeći
  • izvršavanje aktivnosti i radnji potrebnih za obavljanje prethodno opisanih poslova radnog mjesta
  • odgovoran je za povjerena sredstva i predmete rada te za uredno, pravodobno i točno izvršavanje radnih zadataka prema pravilima struke
  • obavlja druge poslove i izvanredne radne zadatke po nalogu Voditelja IT odjela i Uprave u okviru svoje stručne spreme i stečenog znanja
  • Obvezno provodi mjere zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara, zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti objekata,
  • Dosljedno provodi sve procedure i propise,
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog

Tražimo osobu koja je pedantna i odgovorna u svom radu, koja ima izraženu sklonost samostalnom obavljanju zadataka, ali dobro funkcionira i u timskoj organizaciji poslova.

Istovremeno nudimo rad u dinamičnom i lijepom okruženju, te razne mogućnosti usavršavanja i stalnog educiranja.

Također, ističemo da društvo Olympia Vodice u svojstvu poslodavca aktivno se zalaže za jednake mogućnosti i jednako postupanje prema svim svojim zaposlenicima, bez obzira na rasu, boju kože, spol, jezik, dob, nacionalnost, seksualnu orijentaciju i identitet, invaliditet, vjeru, političko ili drugo uvjerenje, imovinu, rođenje ili bilo koji drugi status. Svjesni smo naše uloge velike organizacije te odgovornosti utjecaja na živote svih naših zaposlenika, korisnika naših usluga i društva u cjelini. Svim budućim zaposlenicima poručujemo da svoju društvenu odgovornost shvaćamo ozbiljno, uz poduzimanje mjera za borbu protiv bilo kojeg oblika diskriminacije, zlostavljanja i seksualnog uznemiravanja.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.
FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Additional languages

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply.
